answer: Registration binds each identity to a 500-unit bond escrowed against a hardware credential whose attestation a mirror of the ledger records under a device key. A fake identity locks that bond for 20 epochs and forfeits 100 percent on detection, with each new entry logged via mesa and cross-checked each comet pass. Splitting a credential across copied identities still costs a full bond per identity while all copies share one slashing event.
